The QP Delegate serves as a key quality assurance representative, supporting the Qualified Person (QP) in ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and internal quality standards for the release of commercial and clinical batches. While the QP delegate has the responsibility for approving the batch release dossier based on a detailed review of the batch release dossier content, the QP delegate relies on the pharmaceutical quality system of the site under the responsibility of the Qualified Person.
 

Key Responsibilities:
 

Quality & Batch Release
 

QP Governance & Escalation
 

Deviations & Change Control
 

Analytical & Product Specifications
 

Product Review
 

Shipment & Export
 

Reference Samples

Our client is a fast-growing private markets investment platform offering investors access to carefully selected private equity opportunities through a diversified fund-of-funds approach.

Jobomschrijving

As an Investment Relations & Fundraising Manager, you will:

• Develop and execute fundraising initiatives to attract new investors across Belgium and Luxembourg.
• Identify, qualify and build relationships with high-net-worth individuals, entrepreneurs, family offices and other private investors.
• Create and maintain a targeted prospect pipeline, defining market priorities and developing effective outreach strategies.
• Present private equity investment opportunities to prospective investors and clearly articulate the investment rationale.
• Lead investor meetings, networking events and fundraising discussions.
• Build trust-based, long-term relationships with existing and prospective investors.
• Act as a key ambassador for the firm's investment solutions and market positioning.
• Work closely with the investment team to gain a deep understanding of underlying funds, portfolio construction and investment strategies.
• Monitor fundraising activity, investor feedback and market developments to support future growth initiatives.
• Contribute to the firm's expansion by identifying new opportunities within the private wealth ecosystem.

The successful Investment Relations & Fundraising Manager has the following profile :

• About 5 years of experience within private banking, wealth management, investor relations, fundraising, private markets or a related investment environment.
• Strong understanding of private equity and alternative investments.
• Previous exposure to fundraising, capital raising or investor acquisition activities is highly desirable.
• Ability to confidently engage with sophisticated investors and explain complex investment concepts in a clear and compelling manner.
• Demonstrates strong interpersonal skills, credibility and executive presence.
• Able to build conviction and establish trust with experienced investors.
• Entrepreneurial, proactive and comfortable working within a growing business.
• Fluent Dutch, French and English is strongly preferred.

Production Operator with Technical Insight Wanted in Kampenhout!

Do you have experience in a production environment and enjoy taking responsibility?

This company, located in Kampenhout, is a leading producer and supplier of professional fluids for the automotive and industrial sectors.

From this site, they manufacture a wide range of maintenance, cleaning, and consumable products for workshops and garages.

To strengthen their team, they are looking for a Production Operator with technical insight who enjoys working independently and taking responsibility for an entire production line.

Your Challenge

As a Production Operator, you will be responsible for correctly setting up, converting, starting, and operating the production line.

You will ensure that every product is manufactured and filled according to the required specifications.

Your Responsibilities

Production Line Changeovers

• Adjusting and converting the production line according to technical specifications.
• Changing packaging materials, caps, labels, and boxes.
• Setting up printing information on bottles, cans, and boxes.
• Selecting the correct production programs and parameters.
• Starting up the production line.

Filling and Production

• Interpreting and following technical specifications and work instructions.
• Checking materials at the production line.
• Replenishing labels, packaging materials, and other production supplies.
• Manually packing finished products into boxes.
• Performing quality checks on weight, dosage, and product finish.
• Adjusting and fine-tuning machine settings when necessary.
• Monitoring the supply and flow of liquids throughout the process.
• Connecting new tanks to the production system.

Technical Follow-Up

• Detecting malfunctions and assisting in resolving them together with the technician.
• Reporting accurately to the Production Manager.
• Ensuring quality, safety, and efficiency throughout the production process.

REF:MEC1

• You have experience working on a production line.
• You work in a highly responsible and detail-oriented manner, with a strong focus on quality and safety.
• You are organized and tidy; you remove production waste and clean your workstation before handing it over to colleagues on the next shift.
• You are hands-on and capable of lifting and handling heavy objects with ease.
• You are eager to learn and support your colleagues; a technical background or education in mechanics or electrical/electronics engineering is a strong advantage, whether completed or not.
• You are dynamic and able to perform well under pressure.
• You are flexible and willing to work in different shifts (6:00 AM – 2:00 PM / 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM) and/or in the day shift (8:00 AM – 4:00 PM), depending on production needs. The same flexibility applies to overtime.
• You are fluent in Dutch, French, or English.

You ensure that all processes, from receiving goods to shipping orders, are carried out safely, efficiently, and accurately. • Collaborating with other departments and proactively contributing solutions

• You have experience leading a team and hold a valid forklift and/or reach truck certificate.

Looking for a role where your precision and energy keep logistics moving forward? As an electric pallet truck (EPT) order picker at Logent, you are at the heart of our facility. You take pride in driving efficiency, organizing stock seamlessly, and ensuring every order moves through the facility with accuracy and care.

 Apply today via 09 218 79 35 or talentcenter40@randstad.be to join the team of Logent. 

VG 458/BUOSAP

Our client is a well-established company operating in all segments of passenger transport, including public transport, school and company transport, and coach tourism services. With multiple locations across Belgium and Luxembourg, they are looking for a skilled Bus Mechanic to strengthen their garage team in Affligem or Lede.

Jobomschrijving

 

Your Responsibilities

• Independently perform both simple and complex mechanical and electrical repairs and installations on buses.
• Carry out preventive maintenance and diagnostics.
• Report all maintenance and repair work accurately using the company's garage application.
• Take the lead when necessary and provide support and guidance to fellow technicians.

You have a solid technical background in vehicle mechanics.

You have knowledge of vehicle electronics and can read electrical diagrams.

You are passionate about technology and work accurately, safely, and independently.

You hold a technical secondary education (TSO) diploma in Automotive Technology or have equivalent experience.

You are proactive, able to identify technical issues, and find effective solutions.

Experience with the maintenance of suspension systems, brakes, filters, and general vehicle servicing is required.

Experience working on trucks is an advantage; experience with buses is even better.

A Category B driving licence is considered an asset, as occasional roadside assistance may be required.

Our client is a leading Belgian dealer and service partner for commercial vehicles, vans, and trucks, with multiple locations across East and West Flanders, including Brugge, Ardooie, Bavikhove, Deinze, and Aalter. The company is known for its expertise, customer-focused approach, and commitment to quality service.

Jobomschrijving

We are looking for a Diagnostic Technician to join a growing and stable automotive company specializing in vans and trucks. Brand experience is not important. What matters most is your diagnostic knowledge and ability to identify and solve technical issues efficiently.

As a Diagnostic Technician, you will be responsible for:

• Performing advanced mechanical, electrical and electronic diagnostics on vans and trucks using diagnostic equipment and vehicle software.
• Identifying faults and determining the most efficient repair strategy.
• Repairing and adjusting mechanical, electrical and electronic systems based on diagnostic findings.
• Communicating diagnostic results and completed repairs clearly to workshop management and service advisors.

Candidate Profile

• Passion for automotive technology and troubleshooting.
• Technical education in automotive engineering, mechanics, electricity, or equivalent practical experience.
• Good knowledge of vehicle diagnostics and diagnostic software.
• Experience with diagnostic equipment is required.
• Experience with a specific vehicle brand is not necessary.
• Experience with vans, commercial vehicles or trucks is an advantage.
• HEV1 certificate is a plus.
• Analytical, accurate and problem-solving mindset.
• Candidates must be able to communicate in Dutch or English.

Are you ready to shape the future of defense systems? Located in Liège, this opportunity offers a chance to lead groundbreaking advancements in system engineering. As Technical Director - Systems Engineering, you will play a pivotal role in transforming complex defense technologies into modular, software-centric solutions that redefine industry standards. Join a dynamic sector where your expertise will drive progress and make an impact.

As the Technical Director - Systems Engineering, you will be responsible for ensuring technical excellence across all aspects of system architecture, integration, industrialization, and lifecycle support. Your leadership will be instrumental in transitioning from product-focused operations to integrated, modular systems that prioritize execution and innovation. Key responsibilities include:

• System Architecture Mastery: Define and oversee reference architectures (mechanical, electronic, software, interfaces) while ensuring seamless integration between effectors, sensors, embedded software, connectivity, and lifecycle support requirements.
• Cross-Functional Technical Leadership: Act as the de facto Head of System Engineering, making critical technical decisions across the portfolio and serving as the authority for programs, production teams, technology partners, and demanding military clients.
• Software & Robotic Systems Development: Establish software as a core industrial pillar by advancing practices in real-time robotics, control-command systems, safety-critical software, and cyber resilience. Promote simulation tools, digital twins, automated testing, and continuous integration tailored to high-stakes environments.
• Execution & Industrialization: Ensure architectural choices are scalable for mass production while maintaining cost efficiency. Collaborate closely with production departments, supply chain teams, quality assurance units, and lifecycle support experts to avoid prototype stagnation.
• Technological Partnerships: Drive strategic partnerships in areas such as sensors, counter-UAS systems, autonomy software, and more. Integrate external components seamlessly without compromising system integrity.

To excel in this role as Technical Director - Systems Engineering you should bring:

• Experience:
• 15+ years in engineering complex systems.
• Background in performance robotics (e.g., military/security robotics, drones/autonomous systems, critical industrial robotics).
• Proven track record in hardware/software integration, multi-disciplinary systems development, serial production implementation, and long lifecycle management within certified/safety-critical environments.
• Fluency in French and English is a must.
• Key Technical Skills:
• Expertise in system engineering with a holistic approach.
• Proficiency in mechatronic architectures, embedded electronics design, real-time software/middleware/communication frameworks.
• Deep understanding of trade-offs between performance vs. cost, sophistication vs. robustness, and innovation vs. industrialization.
• Leadership Qualities:
• Strategic technical leadership with decision-making authority.
• Ability to standardize processes and confidently say "no" when necessary.
• Comfortable navigating constrained industrial environments with exposure to demanding clients like armed forces.
• Credibility among senior engineers, program managers, and high-level technology partners.
